verses.pali: “Cha, bhikkhave, dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, without giving up six things you can’t realize perfection.

verses.pali: Mānaṁ, omānaṁ, atimānaṁ, adhimānaṁ, thambhaṁ, atinipātaṁ.
verses.english: Conceit, inferiority complex, superiority complex, overestimation, obstinacy, and groveling.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: Without giving up these six qualities you can’t realize perfection.

verses.pali: Cha, bhikkhave, dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: After giving up six things you can realize perfection.

verses.pali: Mānaṁ, omānaṁ, atimānaṁ, adhimānaṁ, thambhaṁ, atinipātaṁ.
verses.english: Conceit, inferiority complex, superiority complex, overestimation, obstinacy, and groveling.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṁ sacchikātun”ti.
verses.english: After giving up these six things you can realize perfection.”
